subject: Take-home assignment launch + reviewer rotation (Senior Eng)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Chen <sam.chen@brightstack.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Take-home assignment launch + reviewer rotation (Senior Eng)

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the next step with us. Attached is the take-home prompt for the Senior Software Engineer role (takehome-prompt-senior-engineer.pdf). A few quick notes:

- Deadline: Please submit your solution by 11:59 PM PT on Monday, June 6 (one week from today).
- Format: A single zip containing code + a short README that explains how to run. Name it Last_First_submission.zip (e.g., Chen_Sam_submission.zip).
- Time expectation: ~6-8 hours of work; focus on clarity and tradeoffs, not polishing.
- If you need an extension for a specific reason, ask as soon as possible.

Review process (internal): Marissa will coordinate reviewer rotations. We plan to have two reviewers per submission (primary + secondary) and a decider if needed. Please treat the prompt as non-confidential within your submission but do not include any proprietary BrightStack material.

Attachments in this email: takehome-prompt-senior-engineer.pdf, evaluation-rubric.md

If anything in the prompt is unclear, reply here (I cc'd Marissa and Aditya for scheduling). Once you upload, reply to this thread so we get an automatic confirmation.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

1) For the performance scenario in section 3, can I assume synthetic data? Or should I use a small real dataset (e.g., public sample) and include instructions for replicating results?

I plan to start tonight and will flag early if I need an extension.

Thanks,
Sam

Thanks Aditya — taking note that you are primary. Laura, are you OK being the secondary?

Aditya — rubric and a short reviewer checklist are in Drive here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDEf-TAkehome-SeniorEng (evaluation-rubric.md in the folder). A few review rules:

- Blind review: do not look at the candidate's LinkedIn / resume during scoring — focus on the submission content.
- Scoring: use the rubric headings (correctness, design tradeoffs, readability, tests/automation, performance considerations). Assign numeric 1-5 per heading and short notes for calibration.
- Conflicts: if you know the candidate personally, flag it and we'll swap in another reviewer.

Marissa — I'll be the decider only if scores are split and we need a final call.

Irene
